خَبْطَةٌ (tropical:) A touch, or stroke, of diabolical possession, or insanity. (TA.) You say also, بِفُلَانٍ خَبْطَةٌ بِالمَسِّ (tropical:) [In such a one is a touch of diabolical possession, or insanity]. (TA.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) A
single act of a stallion-camel's covering of the female. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
